name: Crown of the New Moon

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
This tarnished crown, adorned with a brilliant sapphire, looks almost black. While wearing this crown, you can't contract the curse of the werecreature, and the curse is suppressed if you already have it.

Activate—Moonbeam 2 (concentrate, manipulate, primal)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cast a 5th-rank Moonlight Ray with a spell attack modifier of +22.
